name: Rubyfront of the Wandering Wood
summary: The beast of the walking forest: it folds space, recalls its own Auros, and sends back whatever stands before it.

nexusRequirement.label: Nexus requirement
nexusRequirement.text: Control at least 3 Auros Entities and the opponent has already lost at least 8 HP from their Rubyfront, only in your Preparation Phase

faceA.name: Rubyfront of the Wandering Wood

keyword.name: Fury
keyword.rules: d20 ≥ 12 before every action · failure −1 HP

effect.text: Once per turn look at the top card of your deck: if it is an Auros Entity, you may take it into your hand.

frondRecall.name: Recall through the Boughs
frondRecall.text: return an Auros Entity you control to your hand.

phaseAway.name: Phase Away
phaseAway.text: return an opponent Entity to its owner's hand.

perennialSap.name: Perennial Sap
perennialSap.text: untap up to 1 Auros Entity you control.

faceA.flavor: You do not find the wood. The wood decides to find you.

faceB.name: Folded Glade

effect.text: Once per turn look at the top card of your deck and you may take it into your hand.

perennialBloom.name: Perennial Bloom
perennialBloom.text: untap all Auros Entities in your Front Zone.

foldingTide.name: Folding Tide
foldingTide.text: return up to 2 opponent Entities to their owners' hands.

faceB.flavor: Here space folds upon itself, and what enters no longer finds the way out.
